title: Require authored timestamp for strict native Manifest selection
invariant: When the model requires Atom state, a selected Project Manifest must provide a parseable datetime updated_at to model validation.
scope: Historical selection function with stubbed carrier discovery and model validation, plus the fixed state-field helper. Covers missing, invalid and valid timestamps with require_atom_state enabled; does not exercise carrier parsing, compiled models, Component Manifests, Package Specs, or a complete compiler run. Lean records replay outcomes only.
